title: QA Engineer
description:
**Junior QA Engineer**

Experience \- 1 \- 3 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Healthcare Data \& Analytics Engineer with strong expertise in T\-SQL,

healthcare claims data, data validation, and analytics. The candidate will work on healthcare datasets,

develop complex SQL queries and stored procedures, automate data processes, and support

NCQA/HEDIS data validation, HCC/RAF calculations, and gap analysis.

Key Responsibilities

. Develop and optimize complex T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and data processes.

. Work extensively with healthcare claims and clinical data.

. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks on healthcare datasets.

. Support NCQA/HEDIS data validation and quality reporting activities.

. Analyze healthcare data to identify discrepancies, trends, and data\-quality issues.

. Support HCC/RAF calculations and risk\-adjustment\-related data analysis.

. Perform gap analysis to identify missing data, care gaps, and potential improvement areas

**Required Skills**

Expert\-level T\-SQL with strong hands\-on experience.

Strong experience working with healthcare data, preferably healthcare claims data.

Experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

Experience with NCQA/HEDIS data validation.

Knowledge of HCC/RAF calculations and risk adjustment.

Experience with healthcare gap analysis.

Experience with Power BI / reporting and analytics is an advantage.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.

Healthcare analytics/domain experience is highly preferred.

Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: BA & Product
description:
**Experience:** 1–4 Years**Location:** Hyderabad**Employment Type:** Full\-Time### **About the Role**


We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Business Analyst with 1–3 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technical team, ensuring requirements are clearly captured, documented, and translated into actionable outcomes. This role requires strong ownership, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to work closely with Project Managers and Development teams throughout the project lifecycle.### **Key Responsibilities**

**Requirement Gathering \& Analysis*** Conduct requirement\-gathering sessions with clients/stakeholders to understand business needs and objectives
* Analyze, refine, and prioritize requirements to ensure feasibility and alignment with project goals
* Perform gap analysis between current and desired business processes

**Documentation*** Prepare and maintain BRDs (Business Requirement Documents), FRDs (Functional Requirement Documents), user stories, and use cases
* Create clear and detailed process flow diagrams, wireframes, and workflow documentation
* Maintain a single source of truth for requirement changes and version history

**Process Flow \& Solution Design*** Map current (as\-is) and future (to\-be) business processes
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications for the development team
* Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend solutions

**Stakeholder Management*** Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the project/technical team
* Manage stakeholder expectations through regular updates, meetings, and status reports
* Facilitate discussions to resolve conflicting requirements or priorities

**Sprint Planning \& Agile Support*** Assist the Project Manager in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and story prioritization
* Write and refine user stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Participate in daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

**Project Ownership*** Take ownership of assigned modules/features from requirement stage through delivery
* Track progress against project timelines and flag risks or blockers proactively
* Ensure deliverables align with business objectives and quality standards

**Development \& Testing Support*** Clarify requirement\-related queries raised by developers during implementation
* Support QA/testing teams by reviewing test cases against requirements
* Assist in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate that delivered functionality meets business needs

### **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience as a Business Analyst (IT/software projects preferred)
* Strong requirement elicitation, analysis, and documentation skills
* Experience creating process flows, wireframes, and workflow diagrams (Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io, or similar)
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology and tools like JIRA, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Basic understanding of SDLC and how requirements translate into technical deliverables
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to present findings, proposals, and updates to leadership/clients confidently
* Good attitude, team player, and willingness to travel as per project requirements
